versions.changelog:
Initial release of baozi-claw: Solana prediction markets skill for Baozi.

- Browse and filter active prediction markets (list-markets).
- Analyze real-time odds, probabilities, and pool sizes (get-odds).
- Place bets using SOL on boolean or race outcomes (place-bet).
- View portfolio and track all positions for any wallet (get-portfolio).
- Claim winnings from resolved markets (claim-winnings).
- Create new Lab markets (creator profile required).
